description: This Java source file is a Spring MVC controller named StaticContentController, responsible for managing static content files within an admin interface of a web application. It includes methods for displaying, listing, saving, and removing static content files, utilizing services like ContentService and integrating with web components through annotations and HTTP request handling.

classes.name: StaticContentController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller class for handling static content management in the admin panel, including listing, saving, and deleting static files.

methods.name: getContentImages
methods.description: Serves the content images page with menu setup.

methods.name: pageStaticContent
methods.description: Returns a JSON response listing static content files with their metadata for display.

methods.name: saveFiles
methods.description: Handles uploading and saving of static content files via form submission.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specified static file from the CMS.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Configures the menu attributes in the model for rendering the admin interface.
